title: Senior IT Specialist (Robotic Process Automation and AI)

requirements.text: You must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below
requirements.evidence: You must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below

requirements.text: at least one year (52 weeks) of qualifying specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 grade level
requirements.evidence: at least one year (52 weeks) of qualifying specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 grade level

requirements.text: Designing or overseeing large-scale automation efforts using robotic process automation (RPA) tools such as UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate, or Automation Anywhere
requirements.evidence: Designing or overseeing large-scale automation efforts using robotic process automation (RPA) tools such as UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate, or Automation Anywhere.

requirements.text: Analyzing and reviewing automated workflows, including integrations between RPA tools and other software applications, to assess performance, identify gaps, or recommend improvements
requirements.evidence: Analyzing and reviewing automated workflows, including integrations between RPA tools and other software applications, to assess performance, identify gaps, or recommend improvements.

requirements.text: Planning, scheduling, and carrying out end-to-end RPA projects (from business process analysis and bot development through testing, deployment, and performance monitoring)
requirements.evidence: Planning, scheduling, and carrying out end-to-end RPA projects (from business process analysis and bot development through testing, deployment, and performance monitoring)

requirements.text: Serving as an expert or consultant to senior leadership on the feasibility, implementation, governance, or enterprise-wide adoption of RPA or AI technologies
requirements.evidence: Serving as an expert or consultant to senior leadership on the feasibility, implementation, governance, or enterprise-wide adoption of RPA or AI technologies.

uncertain: Here the four competencies are part of the Basic Requirement, so they are counted.
